_policy: Pre-registered targets for the #4250 round that feeds the beat activation into the tempo estimator's 8 s autocorrelation (board #4250, finding #4251), frozen BEFORE any arm was scored, in the shape of q4163_arbiter_frozen.json: numbers below are read from the baseline run of main 6e495e4; the arms are selected on the TUNE halves and the holdout is read once on the chosen arm.
issue: The estimator's ACF reads the SuperFlux combined flux. A memoryless replica of its selection over logged hops (finding #4251) lands on the annotated tempo on 234/344 Ballroom and 244/311 GiantSteps tune tracks with the beat activation as input vs 200 / 224 with the flux (the shipped published tempo: 177 / 209), and 117 vs 121 on Harmonix (shipped 124). The replica is memoryless; the real anchor and filter are measured here.
design_constraint: Only the ACF's input changes (BeatDetector::process, the value passed to TempoEstimator::update). Prior (150 BPM, sigma 1 octave), continuity, seed gate, lock, anchor and the scheduler stay as shipped. The slow pop/hip-hop octave errors are the prior + anchor fold (#4251) and are NOT this round's target; a loss there beyond noise still reverts an arm (P2).

act.what: the hop's beat activation (0-1) replaces combined_flux
act.binary: fosfora-knob-q4250-46a3b7eeeb9e5aff (branch q4250-tempo-input; FOSFORA_TEMPO_INPUT=flux is byte-identical to base2 on 2 tracks)

both.what: activation + onset_strength (flux over its running max), both 0-1

split.rule: sha256(track_id) parity, even -> tune, odd -> holdout, on ballroom, harmonix and giantsteps_tempo

tools.verdict: bench/q4163_verdict.py adapted to this file's targets (q4250_verdict.py)

baseline._provenance: main 6e495e4 (v2.6.0 + #4163 A-D), analyze build, run_bench defaults; bench/q4163_arm.sh base2

targets.P1_tempo: ballroom holdout acc1 >= 0.5718 + 0.05 AND giantsteps_tempo holdout acc1 >= 0.6857 + 0.03 (the replica forecasts +.17 and +.11 on tune; half of that is the bar)
targets.P2_harmonix_no_loss: harmonix holdout acc1 >= 0.6134 - 0.02 AND beat_f >= 0.654 - 0.01 (the replica forecasts -7 tune tracks for act and -1 for both; binomial noise on 194 tracks at p .61 is sd .035 for acc1, so -.02 is a real loss and reverts)
targets.P3_ballroom_beats: ballroom holdout beat_f >= 0.4454 + 0.02 (a right tempo is the grid's precondition on this set)
targets.G1_cmlt_downbeat: harmonix and ballroom holdout cmlt and downbeat_f >= baseline - 0.02
targets.G2_wrong_flips: harmonix holdout anti_locked <= 31 + 3; ballroom holdout anti_locked <= 73 + 5
targets.G3_batida: every batida template's mean beat_f >= baseline - 0.01 (ambient: beats fired on the beatless renders must not rise: mean beat_f <= baseline + 0.03 is NOT a pass criterion, the fire COUNT is checked in the report)
targets.G4_beatless: the 155 clips: publish <= 53 + 5, beats_per_min <= 28.2 + 3, locked_mean <= 0.139 + 0.02, pulse_low_beats_per_min <= 8.4 + 2
targets.G6_cost: no new per-hop work (the ACF already runs on one value per hop); the fixture check_fixture.py must pass on the chosen arm's binary with the knob removed
targets.G7_fixture_and_tests: cargo test, clippy default/analyze/release/xr clean; the hop-sidecar golden fixture passes

selection_rule: highest (ballroom + harmonix + giantsteps_tempo) TUNE acc1 sum among arms passing every tune-side guard and the tune-side reading of P2; ties go to the arm with the higher harmonix tune beat_f
on_miss: a missed target or guard reverts that arm, or is stated with its numbers and explicitly accepted by Kevin; never silently

amendments.why: Both frozen arms missed on the tune halves (finding #4286). act: tune acc1 sum +.1187 (Ballroom .538->.634, GiantSteps .714->.759, Harmonix .683->.661 = miss P2 by .002), beatless publish 53->116, beats/min 28.2->73.9, locked .139->.326, pulse-low 8.4->56.5 (G4), Harmonix anti_locked 21->31 (G2). both: 15/25, same beatless blow-up, Harmonix cmlt .567->.531. Root cause of G4: the zero-lag-normalized ACF reads the sparse activation on beatless material as periodic (replica confidence >= .35 on 23% of beatless updates vs 9% for the flux), so the SEED gate must stay on the flux. The Harmonix losses are off-beat locks from a changed seed time (#4234), not tempo.
amendments.accepted_by: Kevin, 2026-10-21 ('Let's go with 2 and see what shakes out'), from three stated options: stop / this structural arm / a labels round first
amendments.design_constraint_change: The frozen constraint 'only the ACF input changes' is widened to: the estimator keeps the flux ACF for the seed gate and its whole pre-seed path byte for byte (so the beatless publish count is <= the baseline's 53 by construction), and once seeded runs a second ACF over the activation history whose selection (same peaks x ratios x comb x prior x continuity) gives the measurement; the flux reading is the fallback when the activation ACF has no in-range peak. Prior, continuity, lock, anchor, scheduler unchanged. Cost: one extra 2048-point ACF per 6 hops while seeded.

split.what: measurement confidence = the activation ACF's own

splitmin.what: measurement confidence = min(flux ACF, activation ACF); bounds the Kalman gain and the lock support by the flux's confidence

amendments.unchanged: targets, guards, split rule, selection rule and on_miss as frozen; the act and both arms stay recorded as missed

misses_accepted.decomposition: by tempo level of the published tempo: T-level off-beat 7 -> 10 (+3, exactly the bar), 2T-level 8 -> 20 (the tool counts anti > on, and a 2T track has anti ~ on, so half of any 2T population counts; the 2T population grew 41 -> 52), other 6 -> 4. The 2T growth: 8 slow-pop tracks the flux had right (ref 77-110 BPM) that the activation's ACF doubles (the #4251/#4257 out-of-distribution 'and' firing; beat F sum -2.14), offset by 8 tracks 4T/3 -> 2T (+2.01) and 6 to T (+2.5). The 3 new T-level off-beat locks (0859, 0954, 0758) are the #4234 phase lottery: same tempo in both arms, the baseline got the right phase on 0859 through an unlock + re-acquire at 32.9 s the split arm never had.

4 of 20 renders (waltz-10 .968 -> .919, waltz-3 .967 -> .918, waltz-8 .967 -> .948, waltz-6 .960 -> .955) lose only their first 20-30 s; both arms at 96.0 BPM. Sidecar: split locks tempo at 6.8 s (act conf .98) vs flux 10.9 s (conf .13-.27 around the .2 support floor), before the scheduler's acq_fire has set the grid phase; the grid runs 'muted' on a wrong phase until arb_shift at 30.3 s. Same #4234 mechanism from the other side.
